title: Inside the canteen
caption: The plaza canteen now has a furnished, walkable ground floor on days 1–5. Food service is scenery; the kitchen and upper floor stay closed.

sections.title: The front door
sections.caption: Enter from the glazed door facing the fountain and return to the same doorway.

sections.title: Ground-floor dining room
sections.caption: Eight furnished tables, two usable seats, service counter, water and tray return; ambient diners use the existing crowd bodies.

sections.title: After service
sections.caption: The worker leaves and the room lighting warms in the evening. The dining room remains open.
